items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: And he played that steel guitar for years and years with us.

ctx.x: Did you tell me the drummer? Yeah. Um...

I couldn't recall his name right now. And at the time we had a little fellow on the guitars. I think you remind me. By the name of Jimmy. He had one of the... One of the outstanding guitars. Because he had a steel guitar. Steel. It wasn't like these today. Like the Hawaiian? No, it was something like a banjo. Oh, I see. It was a round... A round steel guitar. Made on steel, yeah. A round steel guitar. I don't see any... Since you recall in my mind, I haven't saw it for years. I don't even see it in the showcases…
Any of your brothers play in the band? No, no.
